clock: trace/task_time ts is CLOCK_REALTIME us. t0 below is rebased to this slice's own origin (origin_abs_us = first MODEL_EXECUTE of the slice). Slices from different runs are HOURS apart on the absolute axis and must NOT be drawn on one shared axis -- compare shapes per arm only.

step_pick.excluded: first 5 and last 2 steps (capture / teardown), then the outer quarters of what is left (middle section only), then steps whose per-stream census of HOSTFUNC_CALLBACK/NOTIFY_WAIT differs from the run mode, then steps whose period is more than 15% off the run median
step_pick.picked_because: the consecutive run whose periods sit closest to the run median period (tie-break: nearest the middle)

merged_total.rule: tasks with dur < 0.50 us are not emitted individually; HOSTFUNC_CALLBACK is exempt (0.007 us nodes kept as markers)

coalesce.note: a task with k>1 is k same-class tasks folded into one block spanning the same wall-clock; seam classes are never coalesced
